create_openai_vector_store: create an OpenAI vector store for RAG ingestion with optional TTL expiration
upload_file_to_openai: upload a file to OpenAI for use with assistants and vector stores
attach_file_to_vector_store: attach an uploaded file to an OpenAI vector store with chunking strategy
ingest_document_openai: ingest a document into OpenAI vector store, skipping local embedding and chunking
review_openai_rag_ingestion: review the OpenAIRAGIngestion class that delegates embedding and chunking to OpenAI
